product_overview.tagline: Transform boring barcodes into artistic SVG designs.
product_overview.target_user: Graphic designers and branding professionals seeking visually appealing barcodes.
product_overview.core_problem: Traditional barcodes are visually unappealing and can detract from the overall design aesthetics.
product_overview.success_metric: User engagement measured by the number of barcodes generated and downloaded per week.

user_stories.story: As a graphic designer, I want to generate artistic barcodes with customizable colors and patterns so that I can match them to my branding.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can select colors and patterns; the barcode updates in real-time.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to preview my barcode before downloading it so that I can ensure it meets my design needs.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can see a live preview of the barcode with selected customizations.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to download my barcode in multiple formats (SVG, PNG) so that I can use it in different applications.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can select the desired format and successfully download the barcode.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to see trending styles of barcodes so that I can get inspiration for my designs.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can view a section displaying trending barcode styles based on user data.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to access a privacy policy to understand how my data is used so that I can feel secure while using the tool.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to the privacy page and read the policy.

feature_spec.feature: SVG barcode generation with customizable colors and patterns
feature_spec.user_flow: User selects colors and patterns -> Barcode updates in real-time -> User can preview the barcode.

input.colors: Hex color codes or color picker selections
input.patterns: Pattern options from a dropdown menu

feature_spec.feature: Preview feature to see the barcode in real-time
feature_spec.user_flow: User makes selections -> Preview updates automatically.
feature_spec.input: User selections for colors and patterns.

feature_spec.feature: Download options in multiple formats (SVG, PNG)
feature_spec.user_flow: User selects download format -> Barcode is downloaded.
feature_spec.output: Downloaded barcode file in the selected format.

tech_architecture.database: No database required for MVP; user data will be collected via analytics.

data_collection_plan.privacy_notes: User data will be anonymized and used solely for improving the tool and user experience.

launch_checklist: Implement barcode generation and customization features
Set up analytics tracking for all events
Test the tool for usability and bugs
Prepare privacy policy and terms of service
Promote the tool on relevant design forums and social media
